taskVersion.name: ves-heldout-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station H-06 (survey area H). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 609.8 | 18.27 | 18.27
2 | 213.6 | 1.05 | 19.32
3 | 1311.8 | 4.54 | 23.86
4 | 278.0 | 3.10 | 26.96
5 | 1124.7 | 1.46 | 28.42
6 | 291.6 | - | -

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: H-06
Curve type: HKH (five-layer HKHK-type curve)
Aquifer depth: 23.86 – 26.96 m
Recommendation: Target the moderately low-resistivity zone (278 Ω·m) sandwiched between the two resistive layers at 23.86–26.96 m depth, likely a fractured/weathered water-bearing horizon; plan drilling to at least 28–30 m to confirm continuity and allow for screen placement across this interval, with casing through the overlying resistive layers to prevent collapse.
